texts.title: The Road Abroad
texts.body: The charge will not be heard now. You have left the Reach before the verdict, with what was in your own purse and a few of the household, for a court that has agreed to take you in. The house is still yours. Everything else is not, until the Senate says otherwise.

choices.keep_the_house_by_letter: Run the house by letter, every week.
choices.make_friends_at_court: Make friends at the court that took you in.

texts.title: Called Home
texts.body: The Senate has voted, and the exile of the house may come home. The motion was read out to a chamber that had spent years forgetting the name, and remembered it in an afternoon.

choices.come_home_quietly: Come home at night, and quietly.
choices.remember_who_voted: Make a note of who voted, and how.

texts.title: The Charge Thrown Back
texts.body: The praetor has let the house's own go, and the house that brought the charge has been made to look foolish in front of the whole Reach. A charge against one of the powerful is a gamble. This one was lost by somebody else.

choices.say_nothing: Say nothing. The verdict is enough.
choices.have_it_cried_in_the_squares: Have the verdict cried in the squares.
choices.offer_the_accuser_a_hand: Offer the accuser a hand, in public.
